SA_initialization_note: First SAFE and first neighbour request are observables, not exact initialization completion

parameters.score: midpoint of complete SAFE weighted-energy interval
parameters.best_output: smallest independently accepted SAFE energy upper endpoint
parameters.unsafe_policy: reject; no penalty or prefix energy enters annealing
parameters.initialisation: HEFT construction; uniform-domain H/M/L constructions; random restarts
parameters.uninitialised_after_batch: continue random restarts until SAFE or method deadline
parameters.scope: heuristic decoded subset; no optimality or infeasibility certificate
parameters.parameter_source: algorithmic self-set values, frozen before comparison; no empirical tuning

timing.clock_origin: one caller root before selected scientific imports, input, native initialization and evaluation; serialization separate
timing.execution_stop: cooperative checkpoints, not a hard real-time process stop
timing.evidence_cutoff: one absolute monotonic deadline; no round reset

coverage.scope: Observed phases within fixed300s call; not exhaustive-search coverage or optimality
